messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
An independent appraisal sounds fair as a starting point. I haven’t agreed to a discounted purchase, and we haven’t decided the price or anyone’s share.
I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, but C hasn’t agreed. We haven’t settled on a price, and I don’t know how the will divides the estate.
Thank you. C is right that I could use some money from the estate to start a dance studio. I’m not sure which house option would work best; I’d like that need included in the shared list.
I’d agree to an independent appraisal as a starting point. I don’t have an amount in mind; I’m hoping for a discount because I want to buy the house with my husband.
Yes, those both seem sensible. I’m not sure yet when I’d need the money; I’d need to understand what’s available first.
I don’t know who the executor is, and I don’t have a copy of the will.
I don’t know where he kept his papers or who his lawyer was. I’m willing to help look for the will and identify the executor.
I’m afraid I don’t know where he kept his papers or who his lawyer was.
Yes, that works. I’m not agreeing to a discount; we can discuss price and shares after we know what the will says and have the appraisal.
